Label: Related Partner
Default: none - ORM creates the partner automatically on create (_inherits)
Help: Partner-related data of the user
Description: Link to the user's contact record. Every user owns exactly one partner; all personal/contact data lives there.

Label: Login
Help: Used to log into the system
Description: Login name (typically the e-mail). Unique; used for authentication.

Label: Password
Related Field / Compute: compute _compute_password; inverse _set_password (writes PBKDF2 hash to column)
Help: Keep empty if you don't want the user to be able to connect on the system.
Description: PBKDF2-SHA512 hash (passlib) in column res_users.password. ORM treats it as a write-only virtual field; empty = cannot log in with password.

Label: Set Password
Help: Specify a value only when creating a user or if you're changing the user's password, otherwise leave empty. After a change of password, the user has to login again.
Description: Virtual field used by the form to set a new password; never stored. Writing it sets password.

Label: Signature
Description: HTML e-mail/chatter signature of the user.

Label: Active
Description: Archive flag. Inactive users cannot log in. Separate from res_partner.active (kept in sync on create/toggle).

Label: Home Action
Help: If specified, this action will be opened at log on for this user, in addition to the standard menu.
Description: Action opened right after login (home action).

Label: Groups
Default: method _default_groups: groups of template user xmlid base.default_user
Description: Security groups of the user (roles/permissions). Inheritance via implied groups is expanded on write.

Label: User log entries
Description: Login log (res.users.log rows created at each login; only magic fields create_uid/create_date are used).

Label: Latest connection
Description: Timestamp of latest login, read from res_users_log.

Label: Share User
Help: External user with limited access, created only for the purpose of sharing data.
Description: True for external (portal/public) users: user is NOT in base.group_user. Recomputed when groups change.

Label: Number of Companies
Default: method _companies_count: total number of res.company records
Description: Total number of companies in the DB (UI helper to show/hide the multi-company block).

Label: Timezone offset
Description: UTC offset (e.g. +0300) derived from the user's timezone; UI helper for timezone mismatch widget.

Label: Company
Help: The company this user is currently working for.
Description: User's current/default company. Must be one of company_ids (constraint _check_company).

Label: Companies
Description: Companies the user is allowed to switch between.

Label: Name
Storage Detail: NOT a res_users column - stored in res_partner.name via partner_id
Description: User's display name = res_partner.name of the linked partner.

Label: Email
Storage Detail: NOT a res_users column - stored in res_partner.email via partner_id
Description: User e-mail = res_partner.email of the linked partner. Onchange: setting login to an e-mail copies it here.

Label: ID
Description: Primary key.

Label: Created on
Description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

Label: Created by
Description: Creator user.

Label: Last Updated on
Description: Last write timestamp (UTC).

Label: Last Updated by
Description: Last writer user.

Label: Last Modified on
Description: Technical: max(write_date, create_date) for cache validation; not stored.

Label: Display Name
Description: Technical display name (res.users: not stored; res.partner: stored computed, see list).

Label: Name
Description: Contact name (required in practice for type=contact via SQL CHECK res_partner_check_name).

Label: Display Name
Related Field / Compute: compute _compute_display_name (depends is_company, name, parent_id.name, type, company_name); stored
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Stored computed full name (includes parent company prefix for non-company contacts).

Label: Date
Description: Free date field on the contact (shown as "Date").

Label: Title
Description: Contact title (Mr., Mrs., ...).

Label: Related Company
Description: Parent company of this contact (hierarchy).

Label: Parent name
Description: Name of the parent company (related, read-only).

Label: Contacts
Description: Child contacts/addresses of this partner (active only).

Label: Internal Reference
Description: Internal reference code.

Label: Language
Help: All the emails and documents sent to this contact will be translated in this language.
Selection Values: dynamic: res.lang.get_installed() -> res_lang.code of active languages (live DB: en_US only active)
Description: Language used for e-mails/documents addressed to this contact; for a user also the UI language.

Label: Timezone
Help: The partner's timezone, used to output proper date and time values inside printed reports. It is important to set a value for this field. You should use the same timezone that is otherwise used to pick and render date and time values: your computer's timezone.
Description: Timezone of the contact; for a user it is the user's timezone for date rendering.

Label: Timezone offset
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: UTC offset derived from tz (UI helper).

Label: Salesperson
Help: The internal user in charge of this contact.
Description: Salesperson - internal user responsible for this contact.

Label: Tax ID
Help: The Tax Identification Number. Complete it if the contact is subjected to government taxes. Used in some legal statements.
Description: Tax identification number.

Label: Banks
Description: Bank accounts (res.partner.bank) of the contact.

Label: Website
Description: Website URL.

Label: Notes
Description: Internal notes.

Label: Tags
Description: Tags / categories.

Label: Credit Limit
Description: Customer credit limit (plain float column in base).

Label: Barcode
Help: Use a barcode to identify this contact from the Point of Sale.
Description: Barcode identifying the contact (legacy name ean13).

Label: Active
Exposed on res.users: Yes - as res.users.active_partner (related partner_id.active); res.users.active is a different field
Description: Archive flag of the contact. For a user's partner it is mirrored from the user on create/toggle.

Label: Is a Customer
Default: True  (res.users.create runs with default_customer=False, so a user's partner gets customer=False)
Help: Check this box if this contact is a customer. It can be selected in sales orders.
Description: Contact is a customer (Odoo 12 boolean; no customer_rank).

Label: Is a Vendor
Help: Check this box if this contact is a vendor. It can be selected in purchase orders.
Description: Contact is a vendor (Odoo 12 boolean; no supplier_rank).

Label: Employee
Help: Check this box if this contact is an Employee.
Description: Contact is an employee (flag only; not linked to hr.employee by base).

Label: Job Position
Description: Job position / title text.

Label: Address Type
Help: Used by Sales and Purchase Apps to select the relevant address depending on the context.
Selection Values: contact=Contact; invoice=Invoice address; delivery=Shipping address; other=Other address; private=Private Address
Description: Address type: contact, invoice, delivery, other, private.

Label: Street
Description: Street line 1.

Label: Street2
Description: Street line 2.

Label: Zip
Description: ZIP / postal code.

Label: City
Description: City.

Label: State
Description: State / province.

Label: Country
Description: Country.

Label: Email
Description: E-mail address; for a user this is the user e-mail.

Label: Formatted Email
Help: Format email address "Name <email@domain>"
Description: Computed "Name <email>" string.

Label: Phone
Description: Phone.

Label: Mobile
Description: Mobile phone.

Label: Is a Company
Help: Check if the contact is a company, otherwise it is a person
Description: True = company, False = person.

Label: Industry
Description: Industry classification.

Label: Company Type
Related Field / Compute: compute _compute_company_type; inverse _write_company_type (interface-only field, maps to is_company)
Description: UI-only person/company switch mapped to is_company (do not use in business logic).

Label: Company
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Company the contact is restricted to (empty = shared). Kept equal to the user company on user create/write if set.

Label: Color Index
Description: Color index (kanban).

Label: Users
Description: Inverse of res.users.partner_id: users linked to this partner (here at most one in this DB).

Label: Share Partner
Help: Either customer (not a user), either shared user. Indicated the current partner is a customer without access or with a limited access created for sharing data.
Description: Stored: True if partner has no user or only share (portal/public) users.

Label: Complete Address
Description: Computed formatted full postal address.

Label: Commercial Entity
Description: Stored: top commercial entity (itself if company or no parent, else parent chain).

Label: Company Name Entity
Description: Stored: name of the commercial company entity.

Label: Company Name
Description: Free-text company name typed for a person without a parent company.

Label: Image
Storage Detail: Binary, attachment=True: stored in ir_attachment (res_model='res.partner', res_field='image', res_id=partner id), NOT a column
Help: This field holds the image used as avatar for this contact, limited to 1024x1024px
Description: Avatar, up to 1024x1024 (base64). For a user: the user picture.

Label: Medium-sized image
Storage Detail: Binary, attachment=True: stored in ir_attachment (res_model='res.partner', res_field='image_medium', res_id=partner id), NOT a column
Help: Medium-sized image of this contact. It is automatically resized as a 128x128px image, with aspect ratio preserved. Use this field in form views or some kanban views.
Description: Avatar 128x128, auto-resized from image.

Label: Small-sized image
Storage Detail: Binary, attachment=True: stored in ir_attachment (res_model='res.partner', res_field='image_small', res_id=partner id), NOT a column
Help: Small-sized image of this contact. It is automatically resized as a 64x64px image, with aspect ratio preserved. Use this field anywhere a small image is required.
Description: Avatar 64x64, auto-resized from image.

Label: Self
Description: Technical QWeb helper returning the record itself.

Label: ID
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Primary key.

Label: Created on
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

Label: Created by
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Creator user.

Label: Last Updated on
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Last write timestamp (UTC).

Label: Last Updated by
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Last writer user.

Label: Last Modified on
Exposed on res.users: No - res.users has its own distinct field of the same name
Description: Technical: max(write_date, create_date) for cache validation; not stored.
